description: Read the global or product-specific maximum published quantity on one numeric-inventory channel. Optional productId returns mode (inherit/limit/unlimited), own and effective ceiling, delivery state and reasons; readiness reports disabled inventory writes across all nine numeric-stock channels. Delivery items include target scope, attempted quantity, reasons and optional import reference; submitted means asynchronous processing, not confirmed live stock. maxQuantity null means unlimited. Each tracked SKU publishes min(available after reservations, maxQuantity); this does not reserve stock. Read-only. Use preview_channel_stock_limit before changing or removing it.

productId.description: Optional product/SKU id from search_products. Omit to change the global channel rule.

name: get_channel_stock_limit
title: Get channel stock limit
